p: father shewed kindness to me: Because Nahash received David and his company, when Saul persecuted him he would now show pleasure to his son for the same.
spy out the land: Thus the malicious always interpret the purpose of the godly in the worst sense.
shaved them: They shaved off half of their beards, 2Sa 10:4.

garments in the midst hard by: To put them to shame and villany, while the ambassadors should have been honoured: and because the Jews used to wear side garments and beards, they thus disfigured them, to make them odious to others.
Zobah: Which were five in all.
Medeba: Which was a city of the tribe of Reuben beyond Jordan.
people: He declares that where the cause is evil, the courage cannot be valiant, and that in good causes men should be courageous, and commit the success to God.
seven thousand men which fought in: For this place, read 2Sa 10:18.
